DeepSeekAPI_Model.description: Call DeepSeek models (deepseek-flash by default): text chat, image understanding (autogrow image_slots plus an images batch, merged and capped at max_images) and optional web tools. Thinking is off (thinking=close) for lower cost and latency; switch to low / high / max for stronger reasoning.

user_prompt.name: user_prompt
user_prompt.tooltip: User prompt; if cleared and no image is connected the node raises an error

system_prompt.name: system_prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: System prompt that sets the role and rules; the default is tuned for image understanding

model.name: model
model.tooltip: Model name, e.g. deepseek-flash (images supported) or deepseek-v4-pro (text only)

thinking.name: thinking
thinking.tooltip: Thinking mode: close = off (fastest and cheapest); low / high / max enable thinking, higher is slower and pricier

web_search.name: web_search
web_search.tooltip: Web tool: let the model search the web and cite results (deepseek_web_search). Billed per call, off by default

read_url.name: read_url
read_url.tooltip: Web tool: let the model read links in your message (deepseek_read_url). Billed per call, off by default

api_key.name: api_key
api_key.tooltip: Paste sk-... directly, or env placeholder to read an environment variable. This value is saved in the workflow, so clear it before sharing.

base_url.name: base_url
base_url.tooltip: Base URL, default https://api.deepseek.com (a /v1 suffix also works)

image_slots.name: image_slots
image_slots.tooltip: Optional: click + to add image slots (one image or a whole batch per slot). Slot images are sent before images; the merged list is capped at max_images

images.name: images
images.tooltip: Optional: one or more images. A batch is expanded in order; anything beyond max_images is dropped

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Only used when thinking=disabled; 1.0-1.3 works well for prompt rewriting

max_tokens.name: max_tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Max output tokens, defaults to the API ceiling 384K (1-393216). You only pay for what is generated; lowering it can truncate long descriptions

image_detail.name: image_detail
image_detail.tooltip: Image detail: low downscales to 512x512, cheapest in tokens

max_images.name: max_images
max_images.tooltip: How many images to send (a batch is taken in order, first N kept). The API allows up to 600; the default of 5 just caps cost

3.tooltip: Sources from web search/read, one title - URL per line (empty when web tools are off)

4.tooltip: Raw API response JSON (choices / usage / annotations, all fields)

DeepSeekAPI_Search.description: Search the web via POST /v1/tools/search. No syntax to write by hand: site / exclude / language / date are separate widgets and the node builds the query. Billed per call (about 0.005 CNY), independent of result count.

question.name: question
question.tooltip: The original question behind this search (1-128 chars); helps the engine understand intent. The default is just an example

query.name: query
query.tooltip: Query keywords (1-128 chars). Use the filter widgets in the advanced section instead of writing syntax by hand

after.name: after
after.tooltip: Keep pages published after this date, same as after:2025-01-01

lang.name: lang
lang.tooltip: Restrict language, same as lang:zh,en. Leave empty for any language

count.name: count
count.tooltip: Number of results (1-50). Billed per call, count does not change the price; 5 is enough for an LLM

need_content.name: need_content
need_content.tooltip: Return page content as well; off by default because it is large and costs tokens downstream

api_key.name: api_key
api_key.tooltip: Paste sk-... directly, or env placeholder to read an environment variable. This value is saved in the workflow, so clear it before sharing.

base_url.name: base_url
base_url.tooltip: Base URL, default https://api.deepseek.com (a /v1 suffix also works)

site_include.name: site_include
site_include.tooltip: Only search these sites, same as site:a OR site:b. A full URL is accepted and reduced to the domain

exclude_words.name: exclude_words
exclude_words.tooltip: Exclude pages containing these words/phrases, same as -word. Comma separated; phrases with spaces are quoted

exact_phrase.name: exact_phrase
exact_phrase.tooltip: Match the whole query as an exact phrase (good for error messages or quoted text)

exact_phrases.name: exact_phrases
exact_phrases.tooltip: (match these exact phrases; comma separated; spaces allowed inside a phrase)

before.name: before
before.tooltip: Keep pages published before this date, same as before:2026-06-01

0.tooltip: Structured Markdown summary: header, stats, then link/source/summary per result

1.tooltip: Raw JSON containing the results array

2.tooltip: The actual query sent, result count and estimated cost

DeepSeekAPI_Balance.description: Query the account balance via GET /user/balance. Outputs a one-line summary plus the raw JSON response. The lookup costs no tokens and no money.

api_key.name: api_key
api_key.tooltip: Paste sk-... directly, or env placeholder to read an environment variable. This value is saved in the workflow, so clear it before sharing.

base_url.name: base_url
base_url.tooltip: Base URL, default https://api.deepseek.com (a trailing /v1 is handled automatically)

currency.name: currency
currency.tooltip: Which currency to show in the summary; auto = CNY first, otherwise the first entry. JSON output is always the full response

0.tooltip: One-line summary, e.g. balance: available | CNY 81.00 (granted 10.00 / topped up 71.00)

1.tooltip: Raw API response JSON, e.g. {"is_available": true, "balance_infos": [...]}

DeepSeekAPI_Text2SVG.description: Extracts the SVG from DeepSeek text output and returns it as ComfyUI's SVG type. Accepts fenced svg blocks, unlabelled code blocks and inline <svg>...</svg>; only the first SVG is used. Preview: writes a copy into the output folder and shows it on the node.

text.name: text
text.tooltip: Raw model output; code fences and surrounding prose are fine

preview.name: preview
preview.tooltip: Write the SVG into the output folder and preview it on the node; turn off to only emit the type

0.tooltip: ComfyUI SVG type (connect to any node that accepts SVG)

1.tooltip: Extracted SVG source, handy for copying or debugging

2.tooltip: Bundled expert SVG generation prompt (example/cases/svg-generator-agent.md); wire it into the model node's system_prompt

ImageCompositorHelper.description: Stacks transparent images in array order into one composite: click Open Compositor, drag/resize/rotate/reorder layers on the canvas, save and run. A 4-channel input uses channel 4 as alpha, 3 channels are treated as opaque. Outputs a 3-channel IMAGE, a MASK and the layout JSON.

images.name: images
images.tooltip: Stacked bottom-to-top as image_0 ... image_7; gaps are allowed. 4 channels = alpha, 3 channels = opaque

canvas_width.name: canvas_width
canvas_width.tooltip: Canvas width; 0 = use the saved canvas, else the first image size

canvas_height.name: canvas_height
canvas_height.tooltip: Canvas height; 0 = use the saved canvas, else the first image size

layout_json.name: layout_json
layout_json.tooltip: Layout JSON (x / y / z / w / h / rotation / opacity per layer); invalid JSON falls back to the default layout

0.tooltip: Composite result, 3 channels (alpha lives in the mask)

1.tooltip: Composite alpha of the whole canvas

2.tooltip: Layout JSON actually used (x / y / z / w / h per layer)
